Create one polished landscape 3:2 children’s fantasy storybook painting for a seven-year-old, in the exact painted style of image 1: richly detailed painterly picture book, warm light, tactile moss, stone and wood, gentle expressive faces. Image 1 is a style reference only; do not copy its characters or composition. Image 2 is the exact identity of Jet: a small young dragon with bright red scales, a cream belly, small cream horns, amber eyes and big leaf-green wings. Images 3 and 4 show Grandma, Jet’s old grandmother dragon, exactly as she must look: a dragon snout, dusty rose-red scales, round spectacles, a yellow knitted shawl, curled grey horns, small wings and a tail. Copy her dragon head and body from images 3 and 4. She is fully a dragon with a snout and scales, never a human woman, with no human hair. Scene: night inside a small cosy cottage at the edge of a forest. Grandma and little Jet lean together at an open round window, looking up at a sky full of twinkling stars. Grandma gazes wistfully at one bright star. In the far distance, a tall dark mountain. Draw new natural poses. Full scene, edge-to-edge, coherent perspective and shared lighting. No humans, no boy, no orange dragon. No text, letters, numbers, UI, borders or panels. Child-friendly: nothing frightening, no injuries. Keep every character fully inside the frame.
